The honest case for buying KURUMI now is weak, and I don't think it clears the bar.

What the brief shows in its favor: the coin is alive, classed ORGANIC with no airdrop dump, buyer count is high (265 on the curve, 675 buyers in the first two minutes after graduation), and the top-3 curve share (7%) and top-5 post-graduation share (11%) suggest no single wallet dominates.

What argues against it, and outweighs that: the last 15 minutes show net outflow (-2.45 SOL) with sell-to-buy ratio near 0.94 and 172 sellers versus 181 buyers, so demand is not holding. The coin is down 68% over 30 minutes and 86% off its 30-minute high. Bundled buying is about 30% of the curve, and a launch bot was present. The metadata host is an unfamiliar domain, which the desk can't verify. None of this shows demand that will persist for the next 30-60 minutes.

I'd recommend skipping. A random buy into a coin in this state has no positive case the brief supports.

In the last 15 minutes, sell SOL (108.8) slightly exceeded buy SOL (106.3), with 172 sellers against 181 buyers, so holders are exiting steadily. The first two minutes after graduation show a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.94 and a launch bot, which points to early snipers taking profit into retail demand. A 49 SOL pool is thin: a $20 ticket moves price, and the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost leaves little room for a small bounce to pay off. Dead volume and continued distribution make a dip-buy here a likely loss.
